name: Owed to you
title: Owed to you: what somebody said in one of your meetings they would do by a date that has passed, in the morning brief, with what it was about behind a toggle, a follow-up drafted only when you ask, It came and Dismiss

events.context: You opened What was this about on something owed to you from a meeting
events.drafted: You pressed Draft a follow-up on something owed to you from a meeting
events.chased: You pressed Send on a follow-up to somebody who owes you something from a meeting
events.came: You pressed It came on something owed to you from a meeting
events.dismissed: You pressed Dismiss on something owed to you from a meeting, to ignore it

runs.shown: Rouh put something owed to you from a meeting, past its date, in the morning brief

permissions: reads the action items, people, summary and transcript of your own meetings in your Master, from the meeting library, over the last sixty days
sends a follow-up from Rouh's own inbox to the person who owes it, only when you press Send
accounts: Rouh's own Google inbox, to send a follow-up you press Send on
touches.remove: Turn the switch owed_to_you off on its row in Evolution, Mutations, and the section is gone; to remove it for good revert night 18's commit (rouh/owed_to_you.py, the brief_owed route and its line in rouh/web/brief.py and rouh/project/urls.py, drawOwed, owedAbout, owedDraft and their helpers in briefpage.js, this manifest) and delete the user setting owed_to_you.
